description:
Confused between HDFC ERGO Optima Secure vs Care Supreme vs Aditya Birla Activ One Max? In this video, we compare these three popular health insurance plans and explain their key features, coverage options, and differences.

We cover a quick HDFC ERGO Optima Secure review, a Care Supreme health insurance review, and an Aditya Birla Activ One Max plan review, looking at aspects like coverage benefits, restoration, bonuses, add-ons, and wellness features.

We also discuss important details such as pre and post hospitalization coverage, consumables cover, premiums, and discounts, along with what affects health insurance premium costs.

If you're still unsure which health insurance plan is right for you. Speak with a Ditto advisor for free and get unbiased guidance tailored to your needs- (https://ditto.sh/sqozkw)

📌 *Correction for Care Supreme Plan:*

*Entry Age:*
Adults: 18 years - No Upper Limit (Lifelong)
Children in family floater: 91 days - 24 years

*Exit Age:*
Adults: N/A (Lifelong renewability)
